sample_1.prompt: A young professional woman sitting alone on a park bench in autumn, gaze distant and thoughtful, holding a takeaway coffee cup with both hands. Fallen leaves drift around her. Soft golden afternoon light filters through the trees. Photorealistic style, shallow depth of field, warm amber tones, cinematic composition.

sample_2.prompt: A perfectly still alpine lake at dawn, mirror-like surface reflecting the snow-capped mountains and pastel sky above with flawless clarity. A lone wooden dock extends into the foreground. Absolute silence implied by the stillness of the scene. Photorealistic style, wide cinematic composition, cool blue and pink dawn tones.

sample_3.prompt: A seasoned executive sitting at a boardroom table, leaning back confidently and speaking measured words while colleagues listen intently. His calm, considered expression conveys deep experience. Sleek modern office, city skyline visible through floor-to-ceiling windows behind him. Photorealistic style, shallow depth of field, neutral cool tones, cinematic composition.
